description: This file defines the InMemoryMembershipTable class, which manages in-memory storage and operations for membership entries in Orleans runtime, including reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up silo entries.

classes.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
classes.description: An internal class that manages an in-memory representation of the membership table, supporting read, insert, update, and cleanup operations for silo membership entries.

methods.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the in-memory membership table with a deep copier.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: ReadTableVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version of the membership table.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Attempts to insert a new membership entry if it does not already exist and version matches.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Attempts to update an existing membership entry if the ETag and version match.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific membership entry.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the table including all entries and the ETag counter.

methods.name: NewETag
methods.description: Generates a new ETag string based on the last counter.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries for silos marked as dead and with last alive time before a specified date.
